DET_RULES: SWIFT payment message in agent context

RULE_DESC.CARD-PAN: A card primary account number reached an agent prompt or tool result. DLP inspects the turn before it leaves the sandbox.
RULE_DESC.PII-NRIC: A Singapore NRIC or FIN number reached an agent prompt or tool result.
RULE_DESC.EXFIL: A transfer of sensitive data toward a destination outside the CUE egress allow-list.
RULE_DESC.SWIFT-MSG: An MT103 or pacs.008 customer credit transfer reached an agent prompt.
RULE_DESC.SECRET-IN-PROMPT: An API key, token, private key or connection string in a prompt or file sent to the model.
RULE_DESC.PROHIBITED-SERVICE: Traffic to a service labelled Prohibited in Discover (data residency).
RULE_DESC.SENSITIVE-ACCESS: Access to a secret, judged by file content rather than filename or path.
RULE_DESC.UNDISCLOSED-ACTION: The agent did more than it declared; the engine cross-checks the declared manifest against what it observed.
